verdict.rationale: No evidence shows a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent spec. The probe found 404s at every candidate OpenAPI and Swagger path. The per-endpoint markdown docs contain YAML-like schema fragments, and llms.txt is a documentation index, but neither is a documented, downloadable machine-readable API spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
